$comment: Single source of truth for the package versions this skill recommends, and
for which Carbon major each implementation targets.
The SKILL.md 'Package versions to install' block is rendered from this file
by `npm run sync:versions`, and the build fails if the two disagree.
`scripts/check-upstream.js` reads this file rather than parsing prose.
carbonMajor is load-bearing: writing v11 token names into a v10 project
silently resolves to nothing, which is the sharpest thing this skill knows.
'10-era' means the library ships its own v10-generation CSS rather than
core:false means version-checked but NOT listed in SKILL.md's install block — @carbon/ibm-products is a separate layer, not part of a core setup.

packages.name: carbon-components-svelte
packages.note: Svelte — Carbon v10-era styling, community maintained
packages.majorEvidence: still ships css/g80.css, a theme v11 deleted

packages.name: @carbon/ibm-products
packages.note: Carbon for IBM Products — Tearsheet, Datagrid, create flows
